name: Hawala, Underground Banking and Informal Value Transfer
description: Informal value transfer systems that move value without or alongside formal banking, settling through netting, trade or cash, with limited records. They serve legitimate remittance needs but are also abused for laundering and for evasion of controls.

sources.text: FATF, The Role of Hawala and Other Similar Service Providers in ML/TF (2013)
FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach for Money or Value Transfer Services (2016)
FATF, Money Laundering Through Money Remittance and Currency Exchange Providers (2010)

indicators.name: Unlicensed operator accounts receive many unrelated deposits
indicators.canon: Account collecting funds from many unrelated payers
indicators.desc: A single account receives payments from numerous unrelated senders with no evident commercial or family link to the holder.
indicators.ctx: Personal or business accounts used as collection point for many senders without licence.

indicators.name: Large cash deposits followed by payments to many individuals or businesses
indicators.canon: Large cash deposits followed by payments to many individuals or businesses
indicators.desc: Cash received and paid out to numerous parties abroad or locally.
indicators.ctx: Cash received and paid out to numerous parties abroad or locally.

indicators.name: Settlement via trade, invoices or gold
indicators.canon: Settlement via trade, invoices or gold
indicators.desc: Balancing between brokers is done through goods, invoices or precious metals.
indicators.ctx: Balancing between brokers is done through goods, invoices or precious metals.

indicators.name: Reciprocal payments between operators across countries
indicators.canon: Mirror or offsetting transactions between jurisdictions
indicators.desc: Reciprocal or offsetting payments occur between counterparties or operators in different countries with no direct value transfer.
indicators.ctx: Payments in and out between linked accounts without a direct transfer.

indicators.name: Customer lacks records of senders and recipients
indicators.canon: Customer lacks records of senders and recipients
indicators.desc: No ledger of clients, with limited or no identification.
indicators.ctx: No ledger of clients, with limited or no identification.

indicators.name: Frequent use of money service businesses and exchange houses by the same account
indicators.canon: Frequent use of money service businesses, exchange houses or cash couriers alongside bank flows
indicators.desc: Account activity regularly blends MSB, exchange house or cash courier movements with bank transfers.
indicators.ctx: Multiple MSB transactions and exchange houses, often similar amounts.

indicators.name: Flows to or from corridors known for informal transfer
indicators.canon: Cross-border corridor with known abuse typologies
indicators.desc: Payments use corridors identified in typology reports as high risk, including regions where informal value transfer is prevalent.
indicators.ctx: Payments linked to countries or regions where hawala is prevalent and controls are weak.

indicators.name: Operator reluctant to disclose service model
indicators.canon: Operator reluctant to disclose service model
indicators.desc: Refuses to describe how payments are made or settled.
indicators.ctx: Refuses to describe how payments are made or settled.

indicators.name: Structured transfers below record-keeping thresholds
indicators.canon: Non-cash transfers or loads just below identification or reporting thresholds
indicators.desc: Repeated transfers, remittances or card/wallet loads kept just below an identification, record-keeping or travel-rule threshold.
